notes.title: Kickstarter is now Live!!!
notes.content:
Hello I'm the creator of Twilight's Final Judgement, Julian Davis! I'm happy to announce that on July 1st I had launch the Twilight's Final Judgement Kickstarter. This Kickstarter will help us reach our goals and create the game that has been envisioned. After a long 5 year process of concepting, programming, and writing you can now play the demo but not only that you can support this project directly! I hope to see you there!

Thank you for all the support,
Julian Davis


Kickstarter: bit.ly/3OEWl7Y
